title: Identify the country that hosted the league with the highest number of draw
question: Identify the country that hosted the league with the highest number of drawn matches during the 2015/2016 season, among leagues where at least one player with vision score above 90 participated as a home team player.

prediction.sql: SELECT c."XCL_002" FROM Country AS c INNER JOIN League AS l ON c."XCL_001" = l."XCL_004" INNER JOIN Match AS m ON l."XCL_003" = m."XCL_008" WHERE m."XCL_009" = '2015/2016' AND m."XCL_015" = m."XCL_016" AND m."XCL_013" IN (SELECT p."XCL_124" FROM Player AS p INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130" WHERE pa."XCL_151" > 90) GROUP BY l."XCL_003" ORDER BY COUNT(m."XCL_006") DESC LIMIT 1

arguments.sql:
SELECT c."XCL_002"
FROM Country c
INNER JOIN League l ON c."XCL_001" = l."XCL_004"
INNER JOIN Match m ON l."XCL_003" = m."XCL_008"
WHERE m."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
  AND m."XCL_015" = m."XCL_016"
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Player p
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
    WHERE p."XCL_124" = m."XCL_013"
      AND pa."XCL_151" > 90
  )
GROUP BY l."XCL_003"
ORDER BY COUNT(m."XCL_006") DESC
LIMIT 1
